settings.heading: Our story
settings.subheading: Hive & Leaf began with tea, raw honey and one simple idea: a small daily ritual can take care of you.

settings.heading: Meet Coach [Name]
settings.bio: Coach [Name] spent years helping people build calmer, healthier routines. Again and again, the same thing made the biggest difference: small, steady rituals. Hive & Leaf grew from that idea.

settings.title: Nourish
settings.text: Simple, whole ingredients. Tea leaves and raw honey, nothing added.

settings.title: Move
settings.text: Small daily habits add up. A cup between tasks is a gentle reset.

settings.title: Rest
settings.text: Rest is part of the routine. Slow down and let the day settle.

settings.title: Sourcing
settings.text: We work with small farms and honey keepers we know by name.

settings.title: Tasting
settings.text: Every batch is tasted and adjusted until it feels right.

settings.title: Blending
settings.text: Leaves and honey are blended by hand in small runs.

settings.title: Packing
settings.text: Sealed fresh and sent with care, ready for your ritual.

settings.heading: Start your ritual
settings.text: Pick a tea, add a spoon of honey, and take a slow minute for yourself.
